scope: The synthetic HTTP/SSE fixtures in this repository. This is an explicit audit policy, not a universal API standard.

outcomes.completed: A recognized normal finish event occurred and no higher-priority failure event occurred.
outcomes.failed: An explicit transport, SSE, or failure-finish signal occurred, regardless of earlier role or content events.
outcomes.incomplete: The transport ended without an explicit failure and without a recognized normal finish event.

partial_output_policy.complete_output: Nonempty content attached to a completed request.
partial_output_policy.partial_output: Nonempty content received before a failed or incomplete outcome.
partial_output_policy.no_text_output: No nonempty content event was observed.
partial_output_policy.retention: Retain partial text and its count as failure or incomplete evidence.
partial_output_policy.aggregation: Do not add partial-output tokens to completed-success token totals. Report them separately when the client exposes enough information.

population_policy.attempted: Every request sent by the harness.
population_policy.incomplete: Only oracle outcome incomplete; do not silently fold it into completed.
population_policy.downstream_compatibility: If a client has only success/failure fields, preserve the three-way oracle result separately and state any projection into the client schema.

limits: Only stop is accepted as a normal finish reason for the current corpus.
Only abort is declared as a failure finish reason for the current corpus.
Other finish reasons require a versioned policy update rather than inference.
[DONE] is a stream terminator, not by itself proof of successful completion.
A clean HTTP EOF is a transport fact, not by itself proof of successful completion.
